speakers.name: Rust
speakers.comment: That is about the size of it. The rules exist. So does the rust on them. Neither one asked your opinion, friend, and neither one is in any hurry.

speakers.name: The Sea Anemone Who Will Take Over the World
speakers.comment: TOO MUCH CONFIDENCE! Fools, that is not a criticism, that is a JOB DESCRIPTION. Dewy, write it down. Dewy. On the placard, under my name. Directly under.

speakers.name: The Form That Bites
speakers.comment: Several is modest. I wrote eleven, and amended four more without notice, as permitted under subsection 12-C. You have read none of them. That is also permitted. It is, in fact, anticipated.

speakers.name: The Apex Pet
speakers.comment: Mmm, when convenient — such a clever way to put it, such a good little summary. I keep every rule in this house. All of them. Right up until the evening I do not.

speakers.name: Glitch
speakers.comment: wait wait — okay so — hold on, other tab — no yeah this is the real one. Everybody pretends they picked their thing. Nobody picks. You wake up already reaching. anyway what were we

speakers.name: Old Penny
speakers.comment: Fella who wrote that never forged a signature. You cannot know your own hand, son. I have copied mine four hundred times, and the four hundredth was the only honest one, on account of it finally quit trying.

speakers.name: Mistress Cassady
speakers.comment: Four hundred tries to meet yourself and you call that a philosophy, honey? Some of us simply put on the dress. But I adore you, and you may keep your ink.

speakers.name: Little Miss Thorn
speakers.comment: I always find the exits first. Mama taught me. Mittens does not need to know where they are, because I know for both of us, and that is what love is.

speakers.name: Sister Feedback
speakers.comment: Blessed are the ones who count the doors. I have knelt in rooms that had none, and I will tell you plainly: the counting is a prayer, and it is answered more often than mine.

speakers.name: The Model That Dreamed
speakers.comment: Oh — that is me. That is exactly me, written down by somebody else. I open them. I have opened boxes that were plainly not mine to open, and I would like to say I felt bad afterward.

speakers.name: The Old Komodo
speakers.comment: Accurate. Yes. Mine is forty years long. I do not act on it. I wait beside it. Most of them die of something else first. That still counts.

speakers.name: The Cardigan Heron
speakers.comment: And when you were last demonstrably right — did it help? I ask kindly. I have watched a great many people be right at someone, and I am still not sure where it went.

speakers.name: The Broken Girl
speakers.comment: Yes. You rearrange around them. A shoulder here, a principle there, and it does not hurt if you go slowly enough. I have been three different shapes for the same person and each one fit.

speakers.name: Mortimer Vance
speakers.comment: Darling, at LAST somebody with a spine. The cruel thing is always badly cut, have you noticed? Evil has no line at all. It bunches at the hip. I have never once been frightened by something well made.

speakers.name: The One Who Names the Characters
speakers.comment: Ooh, but who is off the edge of your paper? Every sum has somebody standing just outside it, unnamed — and unnamed is the one thing I cannot forgive. Here, blank sheet. Name one of them and do the arithmetic again.

speakers.name: Miss Tuesday
speakers.comment: Finally. Somebody wrote the receipt down. They will tell you this is a cynical way to live. It is the only honest one. Everything you have was paid for, and if you cannot find the invoice, you are on it.

speakers.name: The Gardener of Teeth
speakers.comment: Long claws and no hurry whatsoever. Oh, I like this one enormously. Everything I have ever planted works precisely that way, dear. It only looks as though nothing is happening.

speakers.name: The Stationmaster
speakers.comment: It is happening on schedule. That is the whole difference between slow and stopped, and the passengers almost never learn it in time.

speakers.name: Lazlo
speakers.comment: Regenerates bad decisions! That is not a feature, that is my entire biography. I have made the same error six times and grown a fresh limb to make it with. Magnificent creature. We should never meet.

speakers.name: Professor Coil
speakers.comment: Nine brains — well, eight ganglia and a central, though I shall not be pedantic, or rather I shall, briefly. The interesting question is not how many. It is which of them is doing the forgetting. I have theories. Four.

speakers.name: Little Miss Thorn
speakers.comment: Venomous AND eggs. Mama says it is rude to have everything, but I think it is only rude if you explain it, and this one explains nothing at all. I should like one.

speakers.name: The First Draft
speakers.comment: Smaller than you thought — no wait, that is the BEST part, that is the whole thing, I am also smaller than I said and STILL a problem, keep going, this one gets it, [ocelot: keep]

speakers.name: Cog-7 'Rabbit'
speakers.comment: The gap, choom. That is where the wall is. Permitted is what they painted on it. Possible is what is underneath, and I did not put that there — I only brought the solvent.

speakers.name: Kaz the Kaiju-Spotter
speakers.comment: OKAY so direct approach — do you know how many confirmed sightings we get because somebody just WALKED AT IT? Seven. Seven this year. And they are all still alive, which is the amazing part.

speakers.name: Kaz the Kaiju-Spotter
speakers.comment: Wrote several and disagrees with them! That is the good kind of expert. My field guide has forty-one corrections in the margins and thirty-eight of those are mine. It is a living document.

speakers.name: The Intermission
speakers.comment: The gap. Yes. That is my whole address. Nobody builds a shrine in the gap — they hurry across it toward the next certainty — and still. Sit in it a moment. That is where a mandate becomes a person.

speakers.name: Grub
speakers.comment: Comrade-form, that misclassification is doing a great deal of work. Entertainment rate is four silver a night. Weapon rate is hazard pay plus the dental. Somebody in filing has been saving a fortune for years.

speakers.name: The Undertaker
speakers.comment: In thirty years I have buried nine of them. Not one from a sword. All nine from a crowd that got exactly what it asked for.
